blocks.text: CHICAGO — Nikola Jokic had 37 points, 18 rebounds and 11 assists for the 202nd triple-double of his career, Jamal Murray scored eight of his season-high 45 points in overtime, and the Denver Nuggets held off the Chicago Bulls 151-145 on Sunday night. Jokic closed the gap on Russell Westbrook’s NBA record of 209 career triple-doubles. Murray was 13 for 22 from the floor, 6 for 11 from 3-point range and 13 for 14 from the free-throw line.
